name: services/slips/trigger_index
description: Get the full list of triggers.
brief_description: Get the full list of triggers.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of trigger method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: Ordered list of trigger objects (currently there are no categories to group them by, just this list).
